name: mpv
description: mpv is a free media player for the command line. It supports a wide variety of media file formats, audio and video codecs, and subtitle types.

user:
meson setup build --prefix=/usr       \
            --buildtype=release \
            -D x11=enabled      \
            -D wayland=enabled  \
            -D vulkan=enabled   \
            -D dvdnav=enabled   \
            -D cdda=enabled     \
            -D sdl2=enabled     \
            .
